observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — overview
observations.content:
Academic low-code MVP: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4 frontend; FastAPI + PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 single-file backend.
Repo: https://github.com/javi2481/document-intelligence.git
Philosophy: orquestar API oficial PaddleOCR 3.x (no inventar); max ~10 app files; sin Docker/DB/colas/auth.
Structure: frontend/ (App.tsx, api.ts, index.css) + backend/main.py + requirements.txt + README.md + .env.example
Formats: PNG JPG WEBP GIF BMP TIFF ICO PPM AVIF. PDF NO soportado.
Run: backend `python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8100`; frontend `npm run dev` → http://localhost:5173 (VITE_API_URL).
Paddle: enable_mkldnn=False; predict() + text_rec_score_thresh/text_det_*; warmup lifespan; device en /health; export annotated save_to_img.
Export: JSON/CSV/TXT cliente + PNG anotado server-side.
Tema dark-first con localStorage (ocr_options).

observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — continue on another PC
observations.content:
git clone https://github.com/javi2481/document-intelligence.git
cd document-intelligence
engram import engram-export.json
engram sync --import
cd backend && python3.11 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8100
# other terminal:
cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev

First start: warmup descarga/carga modelos (puede tardar). Ver .env.example.
Next: pruebas manuales (umbrales Det/Box/Unclip, Conf, export PNG, Device en status bar).

observations.title: Cotejo PaddleOCR implementado P0-P2
observations.content:
**What**: Backlog cotejo: .env.example, text_rec_score_thresh en predict, UI text_det_*, warmup lifespan, /health device, /export/{id}/annotated save_to_img, Run All via inferBatch.
**Why**: Alinear con PaddleOCR 3.x oficial; no inventar APIs (sin det_db_*/use_dilation).
**Where**: backend/main.py, frontend/src/App.tsx, frontend/src/api.ts, README.md, plan/resulttext_nube_inflada.md
**Next**: pruebas manuales mañana.
